title: Illusionist / 幻术师
description:
A standalone mirror-and-illusion character for Slay the Spire 2, with three coupled systems:

- Mirror: "Copy" summons mirror images that replay your first card each turn and shatter when you take unblocked damage.
- Intent: read and reflect enemy telegraphs (Counter, Foresight, Provoke).
- Transmute: temporarily reshape your own cards (Shifting Blade, Myriad Faces, Phantom Blast), with a transmute stack that unwinds one layer per turn.

~40 themed cards, custom relics and potions, a starter relic, and Orobas (Ancient) relic/card upgrades.

Fully localized in English and 简体中文.
changeNote: v0.4.1 - Fixes, balance & a new card. Fix: the energy icon no longer renders oversized inside relic/card description text (most visible on the Ancient/Orobas relic). Fix: Encore now stacks correctly - playing N copies returns N Retain cards from your discard each turn, and its counter shows the stack (previously stuck at 1). New card: Curtain Call (Rare) - a 0-cost, Retain attack that hits ALL enemies for 50 (65 upgraded), but can only be played while no enemy's intent includes an attack. Balance: Prism Shard now grants 8 Block per mirror image (was 1); Accrue reworked into a 0-cost Attack that deals 2, Retains and Exhausts, and doubles its own damage each turn it stays in your hand (Innate when upgraded). English & 简体中文.
